If a live channel has shown no picture by this time, MPTV stops trying and tells you, instead of leaving a black screen while it works through every player it has. Never keeps trying, which can take well over a minute on a channel your provider has removed. Waits your provider asks for are not counted.
Your TMDB API key and self-hosted server address will be deleted from this device, and MPTV will go back to the built-in shared service with its daily share.

The built-in service is shared by everyone using MPTV. If any minute, hourly or daily allowance is used up, TMDB details pause until that window resets; playlist information keeps working. Your own key or Worker removes this allowance.
MPTV Worker · no setup
Leave both blank for MPTV’s shared Worker. A custom Worker URL takes priority over a direct API key. Account sessions remain profile-specific.
Send all MPTV traffic and playback through an HTTP proxy.
This device does not allow MPTV to set exact alarms, so a recording may begin a few minutes late. Recordings start earlier to make up for it.
On a phone, tablet or computer on the same Wi-Fi, scan the QR (or open the URL), enter this PIN, choose your MPTV backup file and tap Send to TV. You then pick what to restore here.
MPTV could not work out how many channels this provider allows.

Many providers never say how many channels you may watch at the same time, so MPTV finds out by opening a few and seeing which ones survive. Anything playing now will stop, and this can take up to two minutes.
Surround — send Dolby/DTS to a real 5.1/7.1 receiver. If it goes silent or stutters, MPTV still falls back to stereo and tells you.
